title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Paste-up Mechanical. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Cassette housing is the discarded look.

options.label: Paste-up Mechanical
options.lineage: prepress paste-up boards, waxed repro, crop marks
options.thesis: The studio is one mechanical. Jobs are waxed art. Nested work is strips. The listing is unused copy in the galley.
options.viewport: Full-bleed mechanical: five register columns of square jobs, tissue scratch at right, stem galley below. HIT a job and it becomes the board.
options.risk: Reads as print-shop costume if crop marks decorate instead of ruling the layout.

raised.raise: Registration as measurement: gutters and live ticks are printer's register on one board, not a HUD.
Listing density: the directory stays hairline stem columns; selection drops the rest to a faint rule field.
Working light: the rack sits dimmer; entering the folio raises the mechanical to full bench illumination. Status is named plus pattern, never color-only.
Ground owns the studio: the paste-up board is the field, not inset cards on grey app chrome.
Crop-mark frame is the layout: right-angle register corners are the only shell. Radius 0.

options.label: Bindery Signature
options.lineage: folded signatures, stitching, opening a section
options.thesis: Opening a job is opening a folded signature. The rack is a stack of sections; the listing is the collating table.
options.viewport: Stacked signatures across the bench; HIT unfolds one into a writing folio with nested lines as folded-in slips.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs land on, because the product already says folio.

options.label: Miura Packet
options.thesis: A job is a hand-sized packet. HIT pulls two corners and the folio deploys as one tessellated sheet.
options.viewport: Compact packets on the rack; HIT deploys one job into a crease-ruled writing field.
options.case: Holds product clarity: packet to sheet is slab to folio. Loses identification: aerospace origami is not a print desk.
options.risk: Gold foil slides back toward cassette orange if the packet is treated as a deck.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: Jobs ride a phosphor graticule. Status is timebase and trigger.
options.viewport: One scope screen; channels overlay; knobs set scale.
options.case: Loses both axes: Jake is not a signal tech, and CRT wells plus knobs are vetoed costume cockpit.
options.risk: Revives CRT wells and a HUD.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.thesis: The studio is a black-and-white barcode lattice. Selection inverts a column.
options.viewport: Barcode columns as the catalogue; a sine lattice as the deck.
options.case: Loses identification (gallery installation) and clarity (no grey, no writing surface, strobe).
options.risk: Cannot host a folio body without breaking the no-grey rule.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Atmosphere by horizon band. Entering a job is raising the house to day.
options.viewport: Night rack; dawn folio; cobalt band as structure.
options.case: Loses both: cobalt is vetoed, and lighting cues are not two languages of work.

options.label: Lawn Capsules
options.lineage: saturated green field with floating pills
options.thesis: One colour owns the viewport. Interface floats as white lozenges.
options.viewport: Green lawn, capsule nav, cream panel with 48px corners.
options.case: Loses both: consumer-app lawn, rounded-in-rect veto, not a making desk.
options.risk: The category default in different paint.

options.label: Elbow Console
options.thesis: Pastel banks on black glass. The elbow frame is the grid.
options.viewport: Elbow-framed color banks; tap blinks a segment.
options.case: Loses both: sci-fi console, not pointer-first writing.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Linear-class project board executed at full craft: columns, cards, a clean sans.
canonCard.viewport: Five status columns of rounded job cards, list below, search in the chrome.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
